question: Vajira Chitrasena of Sri Lanka was conferred the Padma Shri award 2020 for which of the following?

options.text: Enriching India-Sri Lanka ties through Indian classical dance
Enriching India- Sri Lanka ties through education
Enriching India- Sri Lanka ties through social work
Enriching India-Sri Lanka ties through Indian classical music

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enriching India-Sri Lanka ties through Indian classical dance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vajira Chitrasena** is a renowned artist from **Sri Lanka.**
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Shri in 2020, **which is **India's fourth highest civilian honor.**
 
• Her key contribution was in the **field of dance.**
 
• Her work has played a significant **role in enriching the cultural environments of both India and Sri Lanka.**
 
• Through her **Indian classical dance**, she has strengthened ties between India and Sri Lanka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri award:**

 
 
• The Padma Shri award is one of the highest civilian honors in India, regarded as the **fourth highest**.
 
• It was instituted by the Government of India in **1954**.
 
• This award recognizes and appreciates distinguished contributions in various areas of activity such as **arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs**.
 
• The award holds a lower rank compared to **Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan awards**.
 
• Every year, the awards are announced as part of the** Republic Day festivities in January, **and presented later by the **President of India**.
 
• Despite being primarily awarded to Indian citizens, the award can also be conferred upon **individuals of any nationality **who have contributed in a significant way to India or the broader Indian diaspora.
